title: Implement router registration and provider wiring
description:
Complete router registration and provider wiring according to phase requirements. Before editing, inspect:
- runtime/router.py for route registration patterns
- runtime/config.py for provider configuration schema
- agents/provider.py for provider interface.

Perform these steps:
1. Register new routes in router.py using existing patterns
2. Update config.py with provider-specific settings
3. Implement provider wiring in provider.py using dependency injection patterns

Follow existing architectural patterns precisely.
